card.name: Aquarefrão
card.summary: Monstros com a face para cima que compartilham o mesmo nome no campo ganham 500 ATK e DEF.

textEvidence.text: While the resolved Trap remains face-up, each face-up monster sharing a rules name with another face-up monster on either field gains 500 ATK and DEF. The bonus applies once per Trap, not per matching partner. Set monsters supply no public name. Separate copies stack. Negation and source removal end the modifier immediately.

card.name: Comergaboon
card.summary: Quando o oponente Invoca por Invocação-Normal ou Virar um monstro com 500 ATK ou menos: escolha esse monstro e destrua-o.

textEvidence.text: Only on the opponent’s successful Normal or Flip Summon, select the summoned monster if its current ATK does not exceed 500. Destroy that target on resolution. This does not negate the Summon. A Set or Special Summon cannot activate this Trap. A negated activation leaves the monster on the field.
